newsitem.title: USA: Energen closes San Juan Basin acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Energen closes San Juan Basin acquisition.

text.p: Energen Corp said Tuesday it completed the planned purchase of San Juan Basin properties from Burlington Resources Inc on April 4.
The effective date of the acquisition is January 1, and the base purchase price was $77,750,000, Energen said.
Proved reserves in the acquired properties total some 225 billion cubic feet of natural gas equivalent.

"This acquisition not only meets our investment criteria but also will provide a boost to 1997 earnings," chief executive Mike Warren said. "It also is helping fund an increased level of participation in our current-year exploration activities."
Energen said it plans to spend $18.5 million for future development of the acquired properties.

Production from this acquisition is expected to exceed seven billion cubic equivalent for Energen in fiscal 1997, ending September 30, and nine billion cubic feet equivalent in fiscal 1998. The acquisition includes about 1,750 producing wells, with Energen's Taurus Exploration Inc subsidiary operating about half of them.
